<span class="origin-badge origin-badge--bareos">Bareos</span>

Sets debug level.

## Synopsis

```text
setdebug [level=<level>] [trace=<-1|0|1>] [timestamp=<-1|0|1>]
         [hangup=<-1|0|1>] [tags=<tags>] [client=<client>] [storage=<storage>]
         [dir] [director] [all]
```

Words without brackets are required, `[ ]` marks optional parts, `a | b` alternatives, `...` a repeatable argument and `[,...]` a comma separated list.

## Description

Sets the debug level of the Director (dir or director), a File Daemon (client=), a Storage Daemon (storage=) or all daemons at once (all). Level 0 switches debug output off. The running daemon is changed, not its configuration; after a restart the start value applies again.

trace= writes the debug output to a trace file in the working directory, timestamp= prefixes every debug line with a time stamp; without them the setting stays unchanged. hangup= is a File Daemon test aid that drops the connection after n files. A missing level is asked for, a missing target leads to a daemon selection.

## Arguments {#arguments}

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `level=` | integer |  |  |  | Debug level. |
| `trace=` | enum | `-1`, `0`, `1` |  |  | Trace flag. |
| `timestamp=` | enum | `-1`, `0`, `1` |  |  | Timestamp flag. |
| `hangup=` | enum | `-1`, `0`, `1` |  |  | FD hangup flag. |
| `tags=` | string |  |  |  | Debug tags. |
| `client=` | resource | from [`.clients`](../dot-clients/) |  |  | File Daemon. |
| `storage=` | resource | from [`.storages`](../dot-storage/) |  |  | Storage Daemon. |
| `dir` | keyword |  |  |  | The Director. |
| `director` | keyword |  |  |  | The Director. |
| `all` | keyword |  |  |  | Every daemon. |

## Examples

Verbose Director debugging into the trace file:

```text
setdebug level=100 trace=1 dir
```

Debug the File Daemon with time stamps:

```text
setdebug level=200 timestamp=1 client=bareos-fd
```

Switch debug output off everywhere:

```text
setdebug level=0 all
```
